rationale: Both floors are exact rather than a margin below measurement, because there is no measured remainder to leave room for: every `method` and `singleton_method` in these eight files becomes a Callable (309 + 19), and every one of the 1,568 `call` nodes becomes a CALLS edge. The files were picked for the shapes that used to break the walker, not for the score — `class << self` (base.rb), a class nested in a module (cookies.rb), `def` inside a `do_block` (delegator_test.rb, shared_examples.rb), `def self.` inside a `do_block` (json_csrf_spec.rb), `def` inside an `if` branch and behind an `if` modifier (cookies.rb, indifferent_hash.rb), and DSL block bodies throughout. Measured `calls` is 1.008, above 1.0, and the excess is real rather than an artifact: 12 edges come from bare identifier statements (`content_type`, `pass`), which are implicit receiver-less calls in Ruby but parse as `identifier`, not `call`, so langcov never counts them in the denominator. The local-variable worry that motivates a lower floor in other languages does not apply here and was measured rather than assumed: across the whole sinatra checkout only 375 of 14,274 `call` nodes carry no receiver, no arguments and no block, and every one of them ends in `?` or `!` — a form Ruby's lexer cannot confuse with a local read — so the local-variable share of `call` nodes is 0%. Local variables show up only among those bare `identifier` statements, where a binding set collected per `def`/`class`/`module` scope suppresses 20 of 32 candidates here (49 of 120 across the full checkout). The anonymous forms — 215 `do_block`/`block`/`lambda` nodes with no entity — are excluded from `named_funcs` by ADR-0031 and their calls attribute to the enclosing method or module, which is what carries `calls` to 1.0 in a codebase whose real work lives inside `get '/' do ... end`. Eight uids collide, and this is recorded debt rather than a correct merge. Six are the pre-existing static-vs-instance collision -- `def self.call` and `def call` in one class share a qualified name, which predates ATL-096 and is visible on main. Two more are `class << self` widening that same class of collision now that singleton methods are extracted at all. Distinguishing singleton from instance methods in the uid is cross-cutting and is filed as follow-up; the ceiling ratchets down when it lands. METRIC CORRECTED 2026-08-06: `calls` read 1.005 on sinatra, above 1.0, because the denominator counted only `call` nodes while the walker also emits an edge for a bare identifier standing alone as a statement -- Ruby's implicit `self` call (`content_type`, `pass`, `not_found`). Those 146 nodes were in the numerator and not the denominator. `identifier` now counts as a call in statement position only, since the same node type spells every parameter and variable read. sinatra reads 0.995 against a denominator of 14,420, which is the honest number; the walker suppresses 49 of 120 candidates as local-variable reads.
